title: fix(play): prove.codediff-single-pane-keeps-the-view is red — its red control no longer bites
description:
# 🌙 dream: `prove.codediff-single-pane-keeps-the-view` is red — its red control no longer bites

kind: repair · owner: this repo · caught 2026-10-30, in 5.3.verification of #174 · red main

## .the cue that fired
a full `rhx play.run --all` on the tailscale branch: `💥 prove.codediff-single-pane-keeps-the-view
— failed (exit 1)`. the tailscale pr touches no nvim file.

## .the gap, precisely
the play's `old-single-pane` arm is a red control: it replays the old defect and must see the
session die. it reads `session_after_deleted=alive, expected dead` — the old defect no longer
occurs, so the play cannot show its clamp bites, and it fails.

📌 the cause is unverified. the likeliest is an upstream change in the codediff plugin, so the old
code path no longer kills the session; the pinned plugin version in
`4.terminal/4.5.nvim/lazy-lock.json` against the version the control was written for would confirm it.

## .the shape of the fix
1. bisect the plugin: run the control against the `lazy-lock.json` codediff commit, then the one
   the play was written against, and name the commit where the defect stops
2. if the plugin fixed it upstream: retire the local repair and its control together, and say so
   in the play's header; a clamp for a defect that cannot occur proves naught
3. if the local repair still matters: rebuild the red control on the new defect shape, then prove
   it bites — revert the repair, see red; restore, see green (`rule.require.clamp-edge-cases`)

## .why it is not done in the round that found it
the tailscale tree touches no nvim file; the work is a plugin bisect in its own domain.
